title: Tommy Graves - Apollo
htmlContent:
Canadian-based artist Tommy Graves delivers a new song, "Apollo," a follow-up of his recently released single "Just Like Her," released earlier this year featuring "Dom Sawyer." A sound that is catchy, down-to-earth, and pleasing to the ears. 

The song "Apollo" has some friendly vibes without getting lost in the lyrics. The vibe is what captures you right away with a smooth sound in the production. When you listen closely, you hear the freshness in the rhyme approach. The groove makes you move your head and feet to the rhythm, and the guitar strumming blends everything together nicely. Apollo is a great listen; I loved it from the beginning to the end, and it's already on some of my personal playlists.
